# Plugin manifest
`hapi.plugin.json` is the cold-path plugin contract. HAPI validates it before importing any runtime entry.
Supported plugin API version: `0.1`

## Minimal example

```json
{
    "id": "com.hapi.examples.notification-logger",
    "name": "Example Notification Logger",
    "description": "Logs notification events through the Hub plugin notification channel extension point.",
    "runtimes": {
        "hub": {
            "entry": "dist/hub.js"
        }
    },
    "contributions": {
        "hub": {
            "notificationChannels": [
                {
                    "id": "logger",
                    "displayName": "Example Logger"
                }
            ]
        },
        "web": {
            "settingsPanels": [
                {
                    "id": "notification-logger",
                    "title": "Example Notification Logger",
                    "description": "Hub runtime sample for outbound notification channels.",
                    "components": [
                        {
                            "kind": "text",
                            "text": "Enable this plugin on the Hub target to log notification events."
                        },
                        {
                            "kind": "schemaForm",
                            "title": "Logger options",
                            "fields": [
                                {
                                    "key": "prefix",
                                    "label": "Log prefix",
                                    "type": "text",
                                    "defaultValue": "[hapi-example-notification]"
                                }
                            ]
                        }
                    ]
                }
            ]
        }
    },
    "version": "0.1.0",
    "pluginApiVersion": "0.1"
}
```
